lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid-like distribution posterior to the pectoral fin and gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity that align with and intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form visible anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features along the upper lateral flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, with light upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral and pectoral regions.
